problem_evidence.production_gap: Retrieved memories are deduplicated and ranked by salience, but no shared layer represents replacement, retraction, expiry, or conditional applicability before working-memory admission.
problem_evidence.persistence_gap: User profile records are append-only in Chroma and the persistent profile collection is not queried by the current working-memory path. Session preference replacement is lost when session state is cleared.

research_basis.title: LongMemEval: Benchmarking Chat Assistants on Long-Term Interactive Memory
research_basis.relevance: Treats temporal reasoning and knowledge updates as distinct long-term memory abilities and separates indexing, retrieval, and reading.

research_basis.title: Keep Me Updated! Memory Management in Long-term Conversations
research_basis.relevance: Shows that unchanged stored memories can become outdated and evaluates selective invalidation while retaining useful long-term information.

research_basis.title: Preference-Aware Memory Update for Long-Term LLM Agents
research_basis.relevance: Motivates dynamic preference updating rather than treating storage and similarity retrieval as sufficient.

causal_hypothesis: With identical fresh memory candidates, query context, reference time, salience scorer, working-memory limit, and expected labels, a generic validity resolver using only typed temporal and relation metadata will preserve history while preventing superseded, retracted, expired, and context-inapplicable records from entering working memory. It will exactly resolve at least 17 of 18 cases, create at least 9 newly exact working-memory sets versus the current all-candidates-eligible control, cause no regression, preserve all multi-valued and legacy cases, and add less than 5 milliseconds median local overhead.
causal_boundary: This pilot begins after candidate retrieval and assumes validity metadata has already been attached. It tests neither natural-language state extraction nor persistent profile migration, vector retrieval recall, final answer quality, RightBrain realization, personality, reflection, or broad human likeness.

current_all_candidates_eligible_control.description: Current behavior: every retrieved candidate remains eligible and is passed directly to the unchanged salience ranker.

generic_validity_resolver_treatment.description: Partition records into eligible, historical, or context-inapplicable using generic metadata, then pass only eligible records to the same salience ranker.

only_changed_component: whether a temporal and contextual validity resolver runs before the existing salience ranker

validity_contract.legacy_rule: A candidate without validity-contract fields remains eligible.

decision_rule.all_gates_pass: Authorize a separate production-compatible shadow integration that reads typed metadata but leaves legacy records unchanged.
decision_rule.any_gate_fails: Freeze the result, do not change the production runtime, and diagnose whether the contract over-suppresses valid memory or lacks needed state.
decision_rule.production_integration: Not authorized by this pilot alone. Natural-language extraction and persistent metadata writes require separate fresh evidence.

stop_conditions: Stop on dirty tracked tree, artifact drift, prior-text overlap, or expected-label leakage into implementation.
Do not change labels, cases, gates, or partitions after candidate implementation begins.
Do not add case IDs, case text, predicate names, or family-specific rules to the resolver.
Do not claim final-answer or broad human-likeness improvement from this component pilot.
